json_storage.reason: Portable behavior across MySQL 5.7+ and MariaDB 10.4+.

migration_state.target_version_rule: Highest contiguous registered numbered migration; never the plugin release version.
migration_state.ready_invariant: installed_version equals target_version, state is ready, and no schema_migration lease is active.
migration_state.version_commit_rule: Advance installed_version only after the migration postconditions pass.
migration_state.downgrade_rule: Never run a downgrade automatically; installed_version greater than target_version enters blocked_newer.
migration_state.failure_rule: Retain the last committed installed_version, store a stable redacted error code, release or expire the lease, and fail closed.
migration_state.background_rule: Data transforms may enter awaiting_background; schema-dependent report generation remains blocked until completion.
migration_state.fresh_install_rule: Run the same ordered migration chain from version 0; do not maintain a divergent fresh-install schema path.
migration_state.lock_rule: Acquire by an atomic insert or expired-lease takeover, compare the owner token hash for heartbeat/release, and increment fencing_token on every acquisition.

schema_version.purpose: Per-site singleton schema and migration state.

locks.purpose: Fenced per-site leases for migrations, schedules, jobs, and other concurrency domains.

forms.purpose: Discovered source-form identity, adapter capabilities, and schema state.

form_fields.purpose: Stable normalized field definitions with inactive-history retention.

submissions.purpose: Normalized submission index and source identity.

submission_snapshot.purpose: Canonical current normalized record used by detail and report paths.

submission_values.purpose: Selective EAV projection for explicitly filterable or sortable fields.

schedules.purpose: Calendar-safe schedule configuration and optimistic edit state.

schedule_fields.purpose: Per-form selected fields, output labels, order, and rendering options.

schedule_filters.purpose: Validated filter expression rows grouped for schedule queries.

schedule_recipients.purpose: Validated To, CC, BCC, failure, and recipient-group targets.

schedule_mappings.purpose: Unified output-column mappings across schedule forms.

report_templates.purpose: Reusable export and email presentation definitions.

reports.purpose: Permanent report run history and reproducibility metadata.

report_files.purpose: Generated-file metadata using opaque relative storage keys only.

report_records.purpose: As-of report row snapshots for reproducible regeneration.

report_deliveries.purpose: Permanent transport-attempt history without asserting inbox delivery.

submission_workflow.purpose: One optimistic-lock workflow record per submission.

saved_views.purpose: Schema-validated private, shared, and default query views.

notifications.purpose: In-app notification state with redacted payloads.

automation_actions.purpose: Ordered validated actions belonging to an automation rule.

audit_logs.purpose: Permanent anonymization-aware business and security event history.

jobs.purpose: Plugin job state correlated to Action Scheduler without duplicating its queue.

sync_cursors.purpose: Per-source/form forward and deletion reconciliation cursors.

access_grants.purpose: Per-site principal-to-resource grants consumed inside repository queries.
